slots.title: Continuous multi-decadal observations link aerosol microphysics to earth system radiative forcing
slots.lead: Four integrated operational pillars sustain continuous, calibrated atmospheric state measurements across fixed and mobile observatories.
slots.s1-body: Southern Great Plains (SGP), North Slope of Alaska (NSA), and Eastern North Atlantic (ENA) provide continuous 24/7 baseline column profiles.
slots.s2-body: Three ARM Mobile Facilities (AMF1, AMF2, AMF3) and the Aerial Facility Challenger 850 target high-priority climate regimes worldwide.
slots.s3-body: Automated ingest pipelines convert raw radar, lidar, and radiometer streams into netCDF Value-Added Products (VAPs) within 24 hours.
slots.s4-body: All observational datasets and LES modeling testbeds are freely accessible to the international research community via the ARM Data Center.
slots.takeaway: Synchronizing dual-polarization radar upgrades with high-resolution LES modeling reduces cloud-radiative feedback uncertainty by 28%.

slots.title: Observatory Infrastructure & Field Campaign Performance
slots.subtitle: Evaluating FY2026 data availability, instrument uptime, and radiative flux closure across fixed and mobile ARM sites.

slots.title: ARM observatories achieved 97.4% calibrated instrument uptime across 460 active datastreams
slots.hero-label: Baseline Instrument Availability Across SGP, NSA, and ENA
slots.hero-context: Automated real-time data quality monitoring (DQO) and rapid field technician response reduced unscheduled radar downtime by 41% year-over-year.
slots.k1-note: Growing by 1.9 TB/day from high-rate Ka/W-band scanning cloud radars and Doppler lidars.
slots.k2-note: Researchers across 290 institutions downloading calibrated netCDF datastreams and VAPs.
slots.k3-note: Mean surface radiative closure residual achieved during clear-sky SGP intensive periods.
slots.k4-note: Intensive Operational Period hours logged across AMF3 Southeast US and tethered balloon ops.

slots.title: Bankhead National Forest deployment captures land-atmosphere coupling in the Southeast US
slots.lead: AMF3 integrates canopy tower eddy-covariance flux systems with scanning precipitation and cloud radars.
slots.h1-body: Tripled Doppler lidar network resolves vertical velocity variance from the forest canopy top through shallow cumulus cloud base.
slots.h2-body: Aerosol Observing System (AOS) characterizes isoprene/monoterpene oxidation and CCN activation under humid continental regimes.
slots.h3-body: Three supplemental extended facilities measure sub-canopy radiation, soil moisture profiles, and sensible/latent heat partitioning.
slots.figure-caption: AMF3 Main Site Tower & Scanning Radar Dome at Bankhead National Forest (BNF), Alabama

slots.title: Contrasting boundary-layer cloud microphysics between Marine (ENA) and Continental (SGP) sites
slots.left-items: Persistent marine boundary layer (MBL) stratocumulus decks driven by synoptic subsidence|Baseline CCN concentrations (80 to 220 cm⁻³) yielding larger cloud droplet effective radii|--Frequent drizzle-induced cold pools and open-to-closed cellular mesoscale transitions| Pronounced sensitivity to long-range North American and European aerosol plume intrusions
slots.right-items: Diurnally forced shallow-to-deep convective transitions tied to surface evaporative fraction|Elevated continental aerosol loading (600 to 1,800 cm⁻³) suppressing warm-rain initiation|--Nocturnal low-level jet moisture transport governing MCS initiation and propagation|Direct coupling between soil moisture heterogeneity and afternoon lifting condensation level
slots.takeaway: Co-analyzing ENA and SGP cloud radar retrievals isolates aerosol indirect effects from thermodynamic boundary-layer forcing.

slots.title: In-situ cloud microphysics probes validate remote-sensing retrievals during overcast IOPs
slots.figure-caption: ARM Aerial Facility Challenger 850 instrumented wing pylons with Fast-CDP, HVPS, and Counterflow Virtual Impactor inlet
slots.caption-title: Coordinated Spiral Profiles Over SGP Central Facility
slots.caption-body: Stacked racetrack legs between 0.5 km and 8.5 km ASL provide co-located liquid/ice water content, droplet size distributions, and interstitial aerosol chemistry directly within the Ka-band zenith radar beam.

slots.title: Assimilating Raman Lidar thermodynamic profiles improves shortwave irradiance hindcasts across all seasons
slots.chart-title: Monthly Downwelling Shortwave Flux RMSE (W/m²) · SGP Central Facility
slots.finding-body: Continuous 10-minute Raman Lidar water vapor and temperature profiles eliminate sub-cloud relative humidity biases prior to shallow cumulus onset.

slots.title: High-frequency scanning radar and LES testbed products drive record community data volume
slots.chart-title: Annual Science Data Volume Delivered to Users (TB) by Instrument Class
slots.c1-body: Dual-frequency Doppler spectra and polarimetric moments remain the highest-demand observational product across ASR working groups.
slots.c2-body: Library of Large-Eddy Simulations paired with SGP and CACTI observations enables scale-aware cumulus parameterization testing.
slots.c3-body: Single-particle soot photometer, ACSM chemical speciation, and humidified nephelometer streams support aerosol-cloud interaction studies.

slots.title: Calibrated multi-sensor suite spans millimeter-wave radar, lidar, radiometry, and aerosol sampling
slots.lead: Standardized calibration protocols across all ARM observatories guarantee directly comparable physical units from the Arctic to the tropics.
slots.row-headers: KAZR (Ka-Band Zenith Radar)|MPL & HSRL (Lidar Suite)|AERI (Infrared Radiometer)|AOS (Aerosol Observing System)|SONDE & RWP (Wind & State)
slots.col-headers: Operating Band|Vertical & Temporal Res.|Primary Retrieved Quantities|Calibration Standard
slots.cells: 34.86 GHz (8.6 mm) / 30 m · 2 s / Reflectivity, Doppler velocity, spectral width / Corner reflector & disdrometer||532 & 355 nm / 15 m · 10 s / Particulate backscatter, depolarization, extinction / Molecular Rayleigh normalization||3.3 to 19.2 µm / 30 to 100 m · 8 min / Tropospheric T(z), q(z), cloud IR emissivity / Dual NIST-traceable blackbodies||10 nm to 10 µm / Surface · 1 min / CCN, N_CN, absorption, chemical composition / PSL spheres & ammonium sulfate||403 MHz & 915 MHz / 100 m · 6 hr / Full column T, RH, and 3D wind profiles (u, v, w) / Reference radiosonde dual-launch
slots.takeaway: Co-locating KAZR, HSRL, and AERI on a shared 2-second to 1-minute time base enables synergistic microphysical retrievals (MICROBASEKAPLUS).

slots.title: Automated ingest, quality control, and LASSO modeling bridge field sensors to E3SM parameterization
slots.rail-sub: Managed at Oak Ridge National Laboratory with federated compute across DOE Leadership Computing Facilities.
slots.t1-a: Real-time raw telemetry from SGP, NSA, ENA, AMFs, and AAF converted to CF-compliant netCDF4
slots.t1-b: Automated Data Quality Office (DQO) bounds checks, calibration drift tracking, and DQR flagging
slots.t1-c: Long-term archival replication with persistent DOIs assigned to every citable datastream
slots.t2-a: ARSCL cloud boundaries combining radar, micropulse lidar, and laser ceilometer detections
slots.t2-b: TROPoe thermodynamic profiles merging AERI infrared radiances with Raman lidar water vapor
slots.t2-c: QCRAD best-estimate surface broadband radiative fluxes with automated shadowband corrections
slots.t3-a: Ensemble Large-Eddy Simulations (LES) forced by ARM variational analysis (VARANAL) fields
slots.t3-b: Instrument forward simulators (EMC2 / CR-SIM) translating model states into synthetic radar/lidar
slots.t3-c: Direct diagnostic benchmarking for DOE E3SM cloud, aerosol, and land-surface parameterizations

slots.title: Phased deployment schedule expands scanning radar networks, UAS payloads, and AI-ready datasets
slots.p1-items: Complete full-year seasonal cycle at AMF3 Bankhead National Forest (BNF) observatory|Commission upgraded solid-state Ka/X-band scanning precipitation radars at SGP and ENA|--Release open-source Py-ART 2.0 and ACT (Atmospheric data Community Toolkit) workflows
slots.p2-items: Deploy tethered balloon system (TBS) supercooled liquid water and ice nucleating particle payloads at NSA|Expand LASSO high-resolution simulations to deep convective and marine stratocumulus regimes|--Launch cloud-native Zarr/Parquet AI-ready observational benchmark datasets at ADC
slots.p3-items: Integrate airborne hyperspectral radiometers and multi-angle polarimeters on Challenger 850|Deploy edge-AI adaptive radar scanning at fixed sites to track rapidly evolving convective cores|--Deliver unified 30-year SGP climate-trend reanalysis product for CMIP/E3SM evaluation
slots.takeaway: All FY2026 to FY2028 facility enhancements align directly with the DOE BER Decadal Vision for high-resolution aerosol-cloud-precipitation science.
